manual_review: All141 punctuation boundaries reviewed; spaced nested closers corrected at2:21 and3:17; cross-verse1:12–13 and4:18–22 retained. No source spelling/punctuation normalized.

index_policy.ordering: One shelf and one complete book; title-only logical page first, then chapters1–4. Source order within each chapter. One-based caller indices differ from stable IDs and native chapter/verse labels.
index_policy.boundaries: 141 manually reviewed punctuation-based sentence units. Speaker introductions remain attached. Closing quotation marks, including spaced nested closers, remain with the preceding terminal punctuation. A standalone unit need not contain a matching opening/closing quote; bounded neighboring context retains surrounding dialogue. Not a universal tokenizer.
index_policy.paragraphs: Paragraph breaks and verse lines are structural whitespace, not automatic sentence boundaries; headings/footnotes are ineligible. Repeated identical text, if present, keeps distinct IDs/paths; no text deduplication.
index_policy.cross_page: Content logical pages correspond to complete source chapters. All four end at sentence boundaries; no split sentence or cross-chapter unit. Future corpora crossing page boundaries require separately frozen ownership/ineligibility. Context never crosses chapter logical page.
index_policy.abbreviation: Manual review found no abbreviation requiring an internal-full-stop exception in this Ruth subset. No general abbreviation/tokenizer support claimed.
index_policy.empty_page: Title-only logical page1 contains genuine source heading, zero selectable sentences and explicit rejection. This is an editorial digital grouping, not a historical blank printed page.
index_policy.offset_unit: Zero-based half-open Unicode codepoint offsets in normalized chapter stream; UI wrapping and source HTML line endings do not change the index.

rights: Publisher explicitly dedicates WEB translation to public domain. World English Bible trademark identifies faithful copies; editorial indexing is labeled separately, source wording/punctuation unchanged. Only complete Ruth subset supported, not whole canon.
